requirement: A compile-valid repair or feature must not complete its task or deliver its patch until separately declared post-change behavioral checks pass. Original and restored states may fail that behavior while passing lifecycle checks.
cases: compile-valid wrong repair refuses acceptance and patch delivery
correct multi-file change checks acceptance after apply and redo
retained outcome completes an explicit checked plan step in a fresh process
source, checker, configuration and declared environment drift refuse stale outcomes
failed and interrupted stages remain incomplete and retain diagnostic reports
oracle: Independent compiled runtime cases and separate patch receiver, plus adversarial protocol tests. No new live-agent or source-equivalence claim.
edit_boundary: The bounded fr guide inspected workflow execution. Cross-cutting Rust, Python, Lean, protocol, test and documentation edits exceed a single admitted author operation and use direct edits.
